note: What the cutter produced. One entry per raw sheet. `method` = how the cuts were placed: whole = single-panel sheet copied as is; cut = every divider sits in a gutter; loose/lost = a divider had to be placed where the sheet still has ink, so a panel may be clipped. `divider_ink_ratio` is the emptiest spot found on the worst divider divided by the sheet's own empty level (1 is a clean gutter). `objects_split_by_a_cut` lists blobs of ink that fall on both sides of a divider, i.e. objects this cut ran through. `background` is the outside colour the ink test used. Panels are cut at their boundaries only: no keying, no alpha, no trimming.
